sections.text: Two things need you today. Overnight Nocturne read 14 things you kept, noticed 3 changes and let 3 go.
The Year 4 trip form is due next Friday. It needs a signature and £12. Your dentist appointment changed. Which is right? Was it Tuesday 17 Nov, 14:00, or Thursday 19 Nov, 10:00?
Leo’s swimming moved from Wednesday to Monday, same time. You decided to book the Lake District cottage for half term. Gran’s new number ends 4471.
Nocturne let go of The old gym door code, The pizza place on Elm Street and 1 more.
Is Leo still doing swimming with Coach Sam? You can answer it on today’s page.
